items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Bud Powell, you know how Bud Powell and them play?

ctx.x: Well yeah, the song has a — the tune has a sound. If you play the sound of the tune I mean the changes are just bringing it through the tune. And if they hook up you do that. So if you’ve got to spell out every chord then you’re dealing with a formula. And Bird dealt with a formula but Bird didn’t do it like that. And some of them who came after him felt the difference between Bird and Sonny Stitt. Sonny sounded like Sonny Stitt. But Sonny Stitt played one way and Bird played another. I mean what Sonny was…
